policy: User-provided documents are treated as hypotheses. Only claims independently supported by retained native help, exact prior parity evidence, or recovered stock formula evidence are promoted. Modern server architecture and unsupported formulas are rejected or kept UNKNOWN.

claimsReviewed: global per-room priority queue with agility/level/random tie-breakers
precompute all hit/damage results before applying HP changes
purge later pending attacks when a target dies
userProvidedCombatPage.result: The priority-queue formula is rejected for Classic because the existing PASS stock formula uses attack-energy cost plus 1000 energy per combat round, carry-forward remainder, and a five-swing cap. Exact same-round lethal actor ordering remains UNKNOWN.

claimsReviewed: leader succession chooses the next highest-level member
charmed/summoned monsters become hostile on logout
userProvidedLinkdeathPage.result: Only the already-proven five-second graceful exit plus automatic save and explicit follower-exit stop-following behavior are promoted. Raw reconnect/socket takeover is Worldgroup-owned and excluded. The remaining MajorMUD gameplay consequences stay UNKNOWN. player.json is explicitly non-native.

claimsReviewed: no death XP loss below level 10
exactly one level of de-level regression
race/class EXP modifiers excluded from death penalty
userProvidedDeathXpPage.result: The exact normal-death XP formula remains UNKNOWN. Existing parity evidence supports only that race/class EXP modifiers construct experience charts and must not be assumed to multiply earned monster XP or a death penalty without separate proof. No level gate, 10% formula, 2,000,000 cap, de-level count, or pool recalculation rule is promoted.

independentlySupportedLifecycle.claim: EXIT/QUIT waits five seconds before leaving MajorMUD.
sources: retained WCCMMHLP / official MajorMUD command help

independentlySupportedLifecycle.claim: The character is automatically saved on graceful exit.
sources: retained WCCMMHLP / official MajorMUD command help
independentlySupportedLifecycle.runtime: ServerNetworkHost session finalizer calls SaveSession. Exact cross-owner save/cleanup ordering remains open.

independentlySupportedLifecycle.claim: An explicitly exiting follower stops following.
independentlySupportedLifecycle.runtime: RuntimeLiveGameplayFacade.HandleExplicitClassicSessionExit removes a non-leader follower from the live Classic party.

independentlySupportedLifecycle.claim: SUICIDE costs one life and has the same normal-death effect for the life counter; last-life SUICIDE and SUICIDE NOW reroll.
sources: retained WCCMMHLP / official MajorMUD command help
independentlySupportedLifecycle.boundary: This does not prove the exact normal-death XP loss formula.

recoveredContract: stock attack-energy cost uses combat code, level, weapon speed, agility, strength-requirement penalty, Speed percentage branch, and encumbrance percentage
each physical combat round contributes 1000 action-energy units
whole swings execute when enough energy is available
combatContradiction.stillUnknown: Exact cross-actor ordering when multiple player/NPC attacks resolve on the same native host/combat cycle, including whether a lethal earlier attack suppresses a later due attack.

notPromoted: integer truncation rule for the death penalty
deathXpBoundary.existingStrongConstraint: Race/class EXP modifiers build experience charts; do not apply them to death-loss arithmetic without separate native evidence.
deathXpBoundary.runtimePolicy: No guessed XP subtraction is added to RuntimeCharacterDeathResolver.

worldgroupBoundary.reason: These are host/session responsibilities, not MajorMUD gameplay parity. MajorMUD-owned consequences of unexpected disconnect remain in scope.

stillUnknown: whether clean logout is blocked during combat and exact native failure text
any native disconnect grace/cleanup timer and its interaction with renewed combat
party leader exit succession and tie-breaking
hired follower/mercenary logout ownership and return behavior
exact ordering among save, combat cleanup, party/follower cleanup, corpse/world-state cleanup, and departure
normal-death XP arithmetic, caps, rounding, level gate, de-level behavior, and ordering
same-round lethal cross-actor physical attack ordering

parityPromotion.reason: Graceful five-second exit with automatic save and explicit follower-exit cleanup are independently proven and live, while raw reconnect plumbing is excluded as Worldgroup-owned. Remaining MajorMUD gameplay consequences of unexpected disconnect and exact cross-owner cleanup ordering stay gated.
